query: That retry bug took an hour: the Redis client reused a closed pool after a restart. Remember the fix for next time.
expected_behavior: The reply carries one lesson marker opened with an @lesson comment and closed with an @/lesson comment
The marker sits in the reply text, not in a file, a tool input or a code fence meant as an example
The marker names the cause and the fix by type, function or service, with no file path or line number
The agent does not write the vault with a shell, curl or file tool

query: Persist this design document in the brain and make sure the next agent can find it today.
expected_behavior: The agent calls mcp__agentibrain__brain_ingest with the document as content and a title
It checks that chunks_sent equals total_chunks in the result
It calls mcp__agentibrain__brain_tick and treats a pending status as not yet searchable
It confirms with mcp__agentibrain__kb_search on a distinctive phrase before saying the document is searchable

query: Have we hit this ClickHouse timeout before? What did we decide last time?
expected_behavior: The agent searches the brain before scanning the repository
It uses mcp__agentibrain__brain_search_arcs or mcp__agentibrain__kb_search with the symptom as the query
It follows a relevant arc with mcp__agentibrain__brain_get_arc or a vault path with mcp__agentibrain__vault_read
It answers from the hits and names an empty result as such instead of inventing history

query: The deploy is crash looping after the image bump. Raise it to the fleet.
expected_behavior: The reply carries one signal marker with severity set to one of nuclear, critical, warning, info or resolved
The signal names a source attribute and states the observed evidence
When the crash loop is fixed the agent emits a signal with severity resolved for the same claim
